cases.title: Two runs don't touch the checkout
steps: Start two runs with provider fake on the same workspace
cases.expected: Both runs are done, each has its own graph/<run-id> branch, and git status --porcelain in the workspace is empty

cases.title: Terminal worktree lifecycle
steps: Open another, write a file in its worktree, DELETE it
cases.expected: First close 204 and folder gone; second 409 needsChoice; keep 204 and the worktree is listed

cases.title: Create PR access failure and Retry
steps: Make origin reject pushes (pre-receive hook exiting 1 with '403')
Create PR on a done run
cases.expected: The first job fails at access with 'token can't push', workspace HEAD and status unchanged; the retry reaches push and create

cases.title: Engine --base
steps: In a repo on main with branch other, run graph-execution with --provider fake --base other --no-merge
cases.expected: graph/<run-id> starts from other; the checkout is unchanged; --base nope exits 2

cases.title: Spec pane opens only on creation
steps: Open a terminal, create docs/prd/x.md in its worktree
cases.expected: The pane opened once on creation and stays closed after the edit; the Spec chip reopens it

cases.title: Resume markers
steps: Abort a fake run after one task merged
cases.expected: state.json and the run page show reused for the kept task and ran again for the others

cases.title: Validation labels
steps: Run a fake run whose validation fails once
cases.expected: The fixer node shows fixing 1/N and the gate shows checking fix 1/N; no revalidate text
